metadata.name: Glass Peaks
metadata.description: A hero background of glowing translucent glass peaks on black under a two-line headline. The peaks breathe in a slow loop and the nearest ones rise toward the pointer. More like this, plus a designer your coding agent can use, at studios.lou15.com/?ref=21st
